name: common_gaussian_copula_with_explicit_ratio_dispersion_transfer
marginal_policy: Preserve every supplied marginal value exactly; generate only the within-cell permutation.

dependence.parameter: One common latent Pearson correlation rho across all four cells.
dependence.calibration_rule: Set tau2=log(1+(ratio_sd/ratio_mean)^2). For each cell set a=right_sd/right_mean and b=left_sd/left_mean. Set rho=(mean(a*a+b*b)-tau2)/mean(2*a*b), using equal cell weights.
dependence.interpretation: A working dependence assumption, not a correlation estimated by either source.
dependence.transport_assumption: Treat the external pooled relative ratio dispersion as an approximate common within-cell log-ratio dispersion for the target hand-level measurements.
dependence.approximation: The external ratio is moment-matched to a lognormal solely to obtain tau2. A first-order delta approximation then gives Var(log(left)-log(right)) approximately a*a+b*b-2*rho*a*b. No exact distribution or moments of a ratio of Gaussian hands are asserted.

pairing_algorithm: For a cell of size m, assign ascending right ranks fixed normal scores Phi_inverse((i+0.5)/m). Draw independent standard normal residuals and form left latent scores rho*z_right+sqrt(1-rho^2)*residual. Associate the ascending left marginal values with the ascending ranks of these latent scores.
measurement_unit: kg; each hand value is the mean of three trials
hand_labels: Anatomical right and left, not dominant and nondominant
